props.text: Walk where the maps run out

children.text: Small groups, local guides and quiet ridgelines. Six-day routes for every pace, with huts booked and bags carried.
Moments from the studio, the shop floor and the corners we love.
It began with a single plot of land and a stubborn belief that good food should taste of where it comes from. We planted what the soil wanted to grow and cooked what the seasons gave us.
Years later the plot is a working farm, the kitchen is full of familiar faces, and the table is still the best place we know to say thank you.

props.text: Feed people the way you would feed family, and the rest looks after itself.
The produce tastes like it was picked this morning, and the staff remember your name. It has become our Friday ritual.
They fed sixty guests at our wedding and not one plate came back unfinished. Calm, kind and wonderfully organised.
A quiet corner of the high street that feels like a friend's kitchen. I bring everyone who visits.

children.text: Tell us what matters most and we will line up viewings that are worth your weekend.
